why: updated, app check passed, and the snapshot restored in a drill
scenario: fresh compose stack (Immich, machine learning off, postgres/valkey as pinned), admin + 1 photo, snapshot -> update -> version/assets -> drill
note: One tested scenario per verdict (fresh throw-away test machine, the scenario field says what was tested), your setup may differ - read the release notes and keep backups.
reported_problems: The People page and name search can be very slow on 3.3.3 with big libraries (one user: 20 to 30 seconds with about 94,000 people) - not hit in our test (immich #32463, closed in 3.3.4)
Face detection on a photo that was cropped or rotated in Immich can put face boxes in the wrong place and remove existing faces and their people - not hit in our test (immich #32499, open)
After a photo is rotated in Immich, its text can no longer be found with OCR search - not hit in our test (immich #32484, open)
Some videos, for example MJPEG AVI from older cameras, do not play with real-time transcoding on, because a wrong frame rate is passed to ffmpeg - not hit in our test (immich #32471, open)
reported_problems_note: Problems other people reported for this release, read by us on the date given. They are NOT part of our test and not verified by us.
